music.what: a light game-night loop: marimba tune, felt-piano chords, soft bass, shaker

bell.what: the Market opens: a counter bell struck twice

clear.what: a full line clears: a rising pentatonic run with a sparkle on top

flip.what: the next Stack dot flips up: a short swish and one bright note

invalid.what: that doesn't fit: two low, muffled notes stepping down (a polite 'nope')

join.what: someone sits down: a little bloop and two plucked notes

place.what: a dot set down: one soft marimba knock on felt

snap.what: a dot clicks into a line: two quick rising wooden notes and a latch tick

tick.what: each of the Market's last 5 seconds: a small woodblock tick

trade.what: a trade lands: two swishes crossing, then two notes

win.what: round won: a marimba fanfare over a warm F chord, with a sparkle

your_turn.what: your turn: a two-note glass chime, rising a fourth
